prompt: A regional gym chain is considering launching an at-home fitness subscription. Its goal is to add $10M in revenue within three years.
model_framework:
Customer demand: interest among members and non-members; willingness to pay
Economics: price, content and app costs, break-even subscribers
Competition: existing apps and their pricing; how the chain differs
Fit with the gyms: cannibalization of memberships; brand and trainer assets
common_overlaps: Demand and willingness to pay often overlap with pricing; keep pricing under economics
